# Medium-ready title and subtitle for the persistent-memory post

## Context

The operator, 2026-11-05: Medium needs a title, a subtitle and a cover, and the hard question is *"what would our target audience prevent from clicking on the preview?"*. The last two Medium posts drew very little traffic, which he traces to title, subtitle and cover, not content. And: *"if we want to change title and subtitle for medium, we should change our blog post markdown file too."* The precedent is #19638 (the Medium-ready multi-window post).

## The Problem

The current title, *"Persistent memory for AI coding agents: load an index, pull the archive over MCP"*, names a crowded category and then the mechanism, in jargon. It has no hook, and the post has no subtitle. Search Console shows only brand queries, so the phrase the title leads with must stay: it is the long-tail search phrase, and the slug matches it.

## The Architectural Reality

- `learn/blog/persistent-memory-for-ai-coding-agents.md` line 1: the H1. The static page's `<title>` and `<h1>` render from it.
- `apps/portal/resources/data/blog.json`: the post's `name` repeats the title with "(part 1 of 8)".
- Design authority: n/a, since this calls no existing behavior wrong. It is a title revision under the blog guide's §1 reader pre-flight.

## The Fix

- **H1:** *Persistent memory for AI coding agents: no prompt stuffing*. The search phrase comes first and the hook after the colon. "Ten agents" stays out, because part 1 covers one agent's slice.
- **Subtitle line under the H1:** *Our AI agents keep 55,041 memories in an MCP server, not the prompt. Each session loads a small index; the agent asks the archive when it needs the past.* The number is the store's count as of 2026-11-03, already in the body.
- **`blog.json` `name`:** matches the H1, keeping "(part 1 of 8)".
- **Unchanged:** the body and the slug.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] The H1 and subtitle are updated, `blog.json`'s `name` matches, and the JSON parses.
- [ ] A cross-family review of the title and subtitle; the operator approves last, at merge.
- [ ] Post-merge: the static page shows the new title in `<title>` and `<h1>`.

## Out of Scope

- The cover image and `og:image`. The static generator emits no `og:image` today; that sits in Julia's SEO lane.
- The empty diagram (#20313).
